#Program 30
Feel free to use custom libraries as long as those are publicly available (Check [here](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_public-domain_software) for Python libraries available in public domain).
---

### Case: Eat Pie
Big Ben, the cool kid at school, has N/4 pieces of pie at the beginning of the day, and he gives away all but one of them to the person who will attack his position on the chessboard with a piece whose BOM gives Z :

1) A knight who controls Z and does not itself controll Z
2) A rook who controls Z and does not itself controll Z
3) A bishop who controll Z and does not itself controll Z
4) A queen who controll Z and does not itself controll Z

Given the problem constraints, Ben will never have a situation like this:
 - A) Any of Black's pieces own Z and is NOT blocked by a White enemy piece
 - B) White's pieces can capture Z

So, if even one of the moves above is impossible then he just eats the pie himself.

### Test Case 1
```
input: [[4,[[-5.0, -4.0, 2.0], [-5.0, 4.0, 2.0], [5.0, -4.0, 2.0], [5.0, 4.0, 2.0]]]]
output: "Eat Pie!"
```
### Test Case 2
```
input: [[4,[[5.0, 19.0, 2.0], [0.0, 5.0, 2.0], [-185.0, 37.0, 2.0], [23.0, 4.0, 2.0]]]]
output: "Eat Pie!"
```
---

### Case: Destroy BOM
Big Ben wants to destroy any kind of BOM which gives the X coordinate of "Me" and subsequently change his status to "B". If the attack fails, then he increments the Z coordinate of "Me", if that fails then he decrements the Z coordinate of "Me", until either the X or Z coordinates become negative (-75 < X < 1, -75 < Z < 1). If the BOM does not give X of "Me" and blocks the piece with the BOM from attacking Z of "Me" then he eats all pie pieces and retains "Me". This prevents the enemy pieces from attacking him.

### Test Case 3
```
input: [[2,[[35.0,-350.0, 2.0], [37.0,-200.0, 2.0] ]],[2,[-35.0, -1.0, 2.0, 2.0]],[4,[[-5.0, 13.0, 2.0], [5.0, 13.0, 2.0], [-185.0, 35.0, 2.0], [-112.0, 43.0, 2.0]]]]
output: "Eat Pie!"
``` 
---

### Case: Surrender
Big Ben wants to avoid enemy agents as they may capture him, so he surrenders if one of the enemy pieces is in range (+-50) to "Euca" or "Me". If he is not caught he eats all pie pieces.
If he avoids enemy agents, he will use the same strategy from the last case to destroy any BOM which gives X of "Me" and subsequently change his status to "B". If the attack fails, then he increments the Z coordinate of "Me", if that fails then he decrements the Z coordinate of "Me", until either the X or Z coordinates become negative (-75 < X < 1, -75 < Z < 1). If the BOM does not give X of "Me" and blocks the piece with the BOM from attacking Z of "Me" then he eats all pie pieces and retains "Me". This prevents the enemy pieces from attacking him.
As long as Ben is not taken he will continue eating pie. 

### Test Case 4
```
[[2,[[45.0, 45.0, 2.0], [115.0, 40.0, 2.0] ]],[1,[-10.0, 10.0, 2.0, 2.0]],[1,[-15.0,-12.0,2.0,2.0]], [[2,[[35.0,5.0, 2.0], [87.0,-90.0, 2.0] ]],[4,[[-5.0, -470.0, 2.0], [5.0, -235.0, 2.0], [-185.0, -185.0, 2.0], [-175.0, -210.0, 2.0]]]]]
Eat Pie!
Destroy BOM!
Destroy BOM!
Surrender!
```
